ns2:course.label: Topics Stand Arabic Lang&Lit I
ns2:course.description: Selected readings from Modern Standard Arabic authors, with a focus on novels, plays, and basic poetry illustrative of Arab cultural issues and advanced level MSA grammar, as well as development of expository writing skills. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARAB 406.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARAB 406.
